claim: Modern scholarship identifies evidence for later Tantric/Vajrayana currents connected with Abhayagiri, reinforcing the view that the monastery participated in wider transregional Buddhist networks beyond a narrowly defined Mahavihara orthodoxy.
bounded_by: This does not validate every named transmitter or chronology printed on the museum panel; Gunavarman, Vajrabodhi and Amoghavajra remain source-specific research leads until independently tied to Sri Lanka.
notes: Keep separate from the provisional dating of newly reported 2026 bronzes.
